folder: Choose an existing iCloud Drive folder. Check that iCloud for Windows is installed and the folder is available.
overlap: Choose an iCloud Drive folder outside your Bmail account and local backup folders.
files: Some local backup files are incomplete, missing, or changed. Verify your local backup and try again.
archive: Complete a local mailbox backup before copying to iCloud Drive.
busy: An iCloud Drive copy is already running. Wait for it to finish and try again.
disk: There is not enough space to copy the backup to your iCloud Drive folder. Your local backup is safe.
permission: Bmail could not write to the selected iCloud Drive folder. Check its permissions and try again.
failed: The iCloud Drive folder copy could not finish. Your local backup is safe. Check the selected folder and try again.
